## NEW: v3.8.20 — August 21, 2026   (previous cache stopped at v3.7.25, Aug 13)

**REPORTED ITEM — ACP data sharing.** New settings "control whether **terminal and user-edit
activity share with ACP agents**."
What is new is the CONTROL; the control is what makes the flow legible. Receiving side, from
docs.devin.ai/desktop/acp:
  - **ACP = Agent Client Protocol: JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdin/stdout; the EDITOR LAUNCHES THE AGENT AS
    A SUBPROCESS.** Open protocol, LSP-analogous.
  - Supported: **Codex, Claude Agent, OpenCode, and any other ACP-compatible agent — "including
    agents built by your team in-house."** So the destination is NOT enumerable from the vendor's
    surface.
  - Third-party agents appear in the **Kanban view alongside Devin**, **share the Spaces context
    layer**, and "operate with the same controls as native sessions" — peers, not sandboxed guests.
  - Available on Pro, Max and Teams.
TWO DATA CLASSES LEAVE THE ENDPOINT:
  - **terminal output** — env vars, connection strings, tokens echoed by CLI tools, failed-auth
    contents;
  - **user-edit activity** — proprietary source BEFORE it reaches version control, bypassing every
    SCM-anchored control.
The setting's state on a machine is the ONLY local evidence the flow is active.
                                                        [reported 2026-08-23, MEDIUM/ENDPOINT]

Also in v3.8.20, scope-relevant:
- **Workspace trust prompts now appear when needed to activate local agents** — local agent
  activation is gated on a per-workspace trust decision the developer makes unilaterally.
  Readable as a posture signal.
- **Multi-root workspaces with virtual filesystem folders** — a virtual root can compose directories
  no single project boundary contains, widening what one agent session sees.

Not reported (QoL): Agent Command Center adapts to selected workspace / converts editor windows in
place / separate-window setting; perf on Agent<->Editor switching; Windows explicit restart
confirmation + `devin` CLI co-update; Linux shared-keyring preservation on upgrade; session tabs
renameable from dropdown; enterprise inline ACU-limit notices; Devin Local plan mode with full
Markdown files + explicit implementation button; individual subagents stoppable without cancelling
a turn; migration wizard over remote SSH; Devin Cloud sidebar filter/sort, live shell output
streaming, "Copy Session URL", network-config conflict reporting.

## Carried forward
- v3.7.25 (Aug 13, 2026) — sessions-sidebar perf (only fetched sessions processed); Devin Local MCP
  auth fix for self-hosted GitLab and older Atlassian.                        [held 2026-08-21]
- Devin Local autonomous mode (v3.4.22) — reported 2026-07-04.

Updated: 2026-08-23 — v3.8.20 is new; the ACP terminal/user-edit sharing setting reported.
